reviewer: Claude (self-review; not a human creative pass)

criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: One focal point per beat (phone, building, map, timeline, cloud); kicker, headline and caption stack in a fixed order.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Playfair headline, JetBrains Mono labels, Inter captions, balanced caption wrapping. Timeline and PoP labels are small (12.5-13 px).

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Portrait-only layout composed inside the safe area. Scene 6 leaves the top third empty and the map sits a little high, with free space under the captions.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Visual beats follow measured sentence onsets; scene holds match reading time. The sentence-level onsets are only approximate inside long sentences (proportional split at commas).

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Captions, headlines and stamps read well at phone size. Timeline labels (12.5 px mono) and map sea label are small and would be hard on a small screen.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: editorial-light: off-white canvas, charcoal line, vermilion incident, ultramarine traffic, marigold warning, emerald recovery, consistent across scenes.

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Camera push through the phone to the map, push into Delhi and pull back carry continuity; scene 3-6 use short dissolves with no whooshes.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Inked outlines, flat fills, dot traffic, ring halos and stamps recur through every scene.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Flame flicker, smoke and traffic dots are all tied to the story; no decorative loops.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Something changes every 2-3 s through 66 s; the closing hold of about 4 s is intentional.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Label collisions found in review (Delhi tag, chips vs Chennai label, PoP label vs ground line, timeline vs right margin) were fixed and re-checked; the phone return briefly overlaps the scene 6 kicker while zooming.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Hook (weightless) to incident to ripple to detour to rebuild to takeaway; ends on the address line with source.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
